summary: Comprehensive backend testing for Concentric (aphasia practice app). 20/20 tests passed across health, content, auth (JWT cookie), and LLM integrations (TTS via OpenAI/EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, scenario generation via Claude Sonnet 4.5, Whisper STT auth gating).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:382 CORS middleware is added AFTER app.include_router. While FastAPI applies it to all routes regardless, conventional ordering is to add CORSMiddleware before include_router for clarity.

server.py:300 TTS endpoint imports emergentintegrations module inside function (cold-import on every request) -- consider top-level import for slight latency win, though it does keep startup resilient if module is missing.
server.py:127 verify_password uses bcrypt directly which is correct ($2b$ format). bcrypt is imported and gensalt() default is fine.
server.py: ADMIN_PASSWORD/JWT_SECRET are present in .env which is fine for dev but should never be committed for prod; flagged as a process concern only.
content.py: Static-only library (10 SFA words, 16 activities total) per user choice -- coverage is appropriate for MVP.
Cookie is samesite=None+secure -- correct for cross-site preview domain. httpOnly is set, good.
test_credentials: Historical shared credentials removed; current live tests require explicit environment configuration.
seed_data_creation: Tests create transient TEST_/dup_/test_ users via /api/auth/register; not cleaned up but use unique uuid suffixes so no collisions across runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_concentric.py covers all 16 backend acceptance points from the request: GET /api/, /api/categories (7), /api/categories/reading/activities (4), /api/activities/reading/receipt, /api/activities (flat with category), /api/sfa/words, register/login/me/logout cookie flow, duplicate email 400, wrong password 401, /api/tts (401 unauth + 200 with audio_base64), /api/generate-scenario (401 unauth, 400 invalid type, 200 with Claude text), /api/transcribe (401 unauth, 422 missing file). LLM endpoints take 5-30s; tests use 60-120s timeouts. Whisper not tested with real audio fixture per request.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Two test failures in first run were due to using `concentric.test` TLD which pydantic EmailStr rejects as a special-use/reserved TLD. Fixed tests to use example.com. Backend behavior is correct.
